findings.title: Recheck the tick budget immediately before spawning
findings.description: `_act` checks the budget before `_launch`, but `_launch` then performs a synchronous journal write before calling `launch`/`Popen`. That write can consume the remaining budget, or a stop can be requested during it, yet the child will still start. Check the budget at the actual subprocess boundary and handle the journaled-but-not-launched entry consistently.

findings.title: Launch output files have no size or retention bound
findings.description: Each child writes stdout and stderr directly to persistent files, with no output cap, rotation, or cleanup after the journal entry is resolved. A pipeline with large or continuous output can grow these files until the supervisor filesystem runs out of space.

findings.title: Add a load test for the Runner’s subprocess workload
findings.description: The Runner introduces detached subprocess launches and repeated polling, but the added tests exercise functional behavior and call-budget checks rather than a realistic load configuration with asserted latency, throughput, or resource bounds. The required load-test tier should cover this Runner path.
